name: Pools
about: A named set of what the machines hold: models, knowledge groups, voices. A role can be filled from a pool instead of one asset, so the work goes to whichever member is free. A pool that lists people keeps its members for them: nobody else, and no work running as anybody else, uses them.

members.label: What is in it
members.hint: Ticked: that asset on that machine. Under Advanced, as JSON, an entry may also be a pattern: "*|name" is that name on any machine, "machine|*" everything a machine holds.

users.label: Kept for these people
users.hint: Nobody ticked: the pool is only a set, and limits nothing. Somebody ticked: its members are used by these people only, an admin included.

prefer.label: Which member, when several fit
pick_from: one that is already running, then the order above
